Hiru represents the vital role that Hanuman plays in Hindu mythology - as a powerful, wise, and loyal servant, accomplisher of impossible tasks, and the embodiment of courage, strength, and loyalty.

The spiritual significance of Hiru extends beyond an earthly moniker, reminding us of the divinity within every human being and the path to seek and realize our inner gold. In a deeper sense, Hiru can be viewed as a moniker for an awakened consciousness - radiant, resilient, and inseparable from the divine.
